Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionEyes locked on your prey. You kill without remorse. After all… it’s either you or them. Sentience fades. This moment is your release. REWARDING MELEE COMBAT Mortal Sin is built around fast, visceral melee combat where every strike matters. Chain slashes, bashes, and kicks into devastating finishers as limbs fly and blood paints the walls. Combat thrives on momentum: move fast, hit hard, and never give your enemies a chance to breathe. ENDLESS REPLAYABILITY Descend into a surreal, ever-shifting nightmare. Procedurally generated levels, randomised quests, and hundreds of hand-crafted rooms make every run feel fresh. Unlock a growing roster of distinct classes, from the great sword-wielding Berserker to the gun-toting Pirate, each with their own play style and wild synergies. SINFUL VISUALS Dive into a bold, graphic novel-inspired world that’s as stylish as it is deadly. Prefer a different look? Mortal Sin now features multiple visual modes and color palettes. Your nightmare, your way. KEY FEATURES - Brutal, skill-based melee with flashy, satisfying combos - Beautiful comic-book visuals, now fully customisable - Dozens of unique enemies that react to your every move - Over a dozen playable classes, each with their own weapons and abilities - A huge arsenal: great swords, spears, guns, claws, and magic - Hundreds of handcrafted rooms across procedurally generated maps - Secret platforming zones with rare loot and hidden horrors - Randomly generated quests with powerful rewards - Multiple color palettes to match your vibe and mood - Infinite runs and future updates to keep the chaos goingShow morePublished byNikola TodorovicDeveloped byNikola TodorovicPlay withXBOX Series X|SCapabilitiesSingle playerOptimized for Xbox Series X|SXbox achievementsXbox cloud saves XBOX consoles XBOX games XBOX Game Pass XBOX accessories XBOX News XBOX Support Feedback Community Standards Photosensitive Seizure Warning User Research at XBOX Microsoft account Microsoft Store Support Returns Orders tracking Store locations Rewards Games Designed for XBOX English (United States) Your Privacy Choices Opt-Out Icon Your Privacy Choices Consumer Health Privacy Sitemap Contact Microsoft Privacy & Cookies Manage cookies Terms of use Trademarks Third Party Notices Safety & eco About our ads

Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionGrab your spray can and step into a colorful adventure in Spray Trace! Control a talented graffiti artist and move through each environment, painting the tiles along your path. But you can't just paint everything you see: each color has an exact number of tiles that must be filled! Move across the environment in four directions and carefully plan your routes. Every tile you pass over is painted with your current color, but retracing a path already painted with the same color makes the paint disappear, allowing you to correct part of your route and discover new solutions. Along the way, you'll find sprays in different colors. Collecting them permanently changes your paint color, completely transforming the possibilities of the level. Choose when and where to change colors, and think a few steps ahead to avoid leaving paint where it shouldn't be! As you progress, new challenges enter the scene. Blocking Tiles can become inaccessible after being crossed, while Clean Tiles must remain completely unpainted until the end. Every movement can change your options, so planning the right route is essential. There is no game over for mistakes, so feel free to experiment! Use Undo or Restart whenever you need and discover the best way to meet every painting objective exactly. Choose your colors, trace the perfect path, and turn every environment into a true work of art!Show morePublished byAfil GamesDeveloped byAfil GamesPlay withXBOX OneXBOX Series X|SCapabilitiesSingle playerXbox achievementsXbox cloud saves XBOX consoles XBOX games XBOX Game Pass XBOX accessories XBOX News XBOX Support Feedback Community Standards Photosensitive Seizure Warning User Research at XBOX Microsoft account Microsoft Store Support Returns Orders tracking Store locations Rewards Games Designed for XBOX English (United States) Your Privacy Choices Opt-Out Icon Your Privacy Choices Consumer Health Privacy Sitemap Contact Microsoft Privacy & Cookies Manage cookies Terms of use Trademarks Third Party Notices Safety & eco About our ads

Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionShe meant well "Your big flower delivery came, so I unpacked it all for you!" Your niece has a spare key and the best of intentions. The shop opens tomorrow, and every flower you ordered is somewhere on the floor. It's okay. You know where they all go. An armful at a time Pick flowers up until your arms are full. Cycle through what you are carrying, find the basket that wants a rose, and set it in. Each basket takes one kind of flower, and it tells you when it is done. Make it yours Every basket can be painted. Pick a colour, or several, and lay them in bands, alternate them round the rim, or scatter them. The finished shop is one you arranged, not one you were handed. No timers No score, no upgrades to grind, no one waiting. Stop when you like and come back to the same floor.
